rows.independentAnswer: Example: 3 daily menu choices for each of 4 days; number of schedules=3^4=81.
rows.reasoning: This is a real-life repeated-choice situation: each of 4 days independently chooses one of 3 menus, so by the multiplication principle there are 3·3·3·3=81 schedules.
